headline: Japan to arrange $6.35 billion in private investment for Bangladesh
summary: The investment, totaling 1 trillion yen, will target the automobile, manufacturing, and energy sectors over the next five years.
details: Japan is set to arrange 1 trillion yen (approximately $6.35 billion) in private investment for Bangladesh over the next five years.
The funding will be directed toward the development of the automobile, manufacturing, and energy sectors.
The announcement is expected to be made in a joint statement during Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's upcoming visit to Tokyo.
According to reports from the Japanese newspaper Nikkei, Tarique Rahman is scheduled to visit Japan from October 26 to 29, with a meeting between the two prime ministers set for October 27.
The Nikkei report suggests that Japan aims to increase its economic cooperation with Bangladesh to reduce the influence of China in the region.
A delegation of Japanese businessmen is expected to visit Bangladesh soon to hold government-private sector dialogues on economic cooperation and investment.
caption:

The funding will be directed toward the development of the automobile, manufacturing, and energy sectors.

The announcement is expected to be made in a joint statement during Prime Minister Tarique Rahman's upcoming visit to Tokyo.

According to reports from the Japanese newspaper Nikkei, Tarique Rahman is scheduled to visit Japan from October 26 to 29, with a meeting between the two prime ministers set for October 27.

The Nikkei report suggests that Japan aims to increase its economic cooperation with Bangladesh to reduce the influence of China in the region.

A delegation of Japanese businessmen is expected to visit Bangladesh soon to hold government-private sector dialogues on economic cooperation and investment.

headline_marked: 16 dead, 65 injured as [[magnitude 7 earthquake hits Tibet]]
headline: 16 dead, 65 injured as magnitude 7 earthquake hits Tibet
summary: The tremor, centered in Nagqu, is the strongest to hit China since January 2024, triggering over 400 aftershocks.
details: A magnitude 7 earthquake struck the southwestern region of China's Tibet, leaving at least 16 people dead and 65 others injured, according to local government reports.
The quake's epicentre was located in Nagqu, a high-altitude city in northern Tibet that is sparsely populated.
More than 300 police officers, including traffic and community personnel, were deployed to the epicentre to conduct rescue operations and emergency relief work.
Authorities have safely relocated more than 12,000 people from the affected areas to safer locations.
The China Earthquake Networks Center reported that 413 aftershocks have been recorded following the main tremor.
Local residents described being awakened by the strong quake and hearing their homes squeak during the shaking.
This event follows a devastating magnitude 7.1 tremor in 2010 in neighboring Qinghai province, which killed at least 2,698 people.
caption:
16 dead and 65 injured after a magnitude 7 earthquake strikes Tibet.

A magnitude 7 earthquake struck the southwestern region of China's Tibet, leaving at least 16 people dead and 65 others injured, according to local government reports.

The quake's epicentre was located in Nagqu, a high-altitude city in northern Tibet that is sparsely populated.

More than 300 police officers, including traffic and community personnel, were deployed to the epicentre to conduct rescue operations and emergency relief work.

Authorities have safely relocated more than 12,000 people from the affected areas to safer locations.

The China Earthquake Networks Center reported that 413 aftershocks have been recorded following the main tremor.

Local residents described being awakened by the strong quake and hearing their homes squeak during the shaking.

This event follows a devastating magnitude 7.1 tremor in 2010 in neighboring Qinghai province, which killed at least 2,698 people.
